caption: The drawing depicts a square object constructed from cylindrical wooden rods forming a frame. The frame consists of four vertical rods interconnected at the corners by four horizontal rods, all with visible rounded ends. Within the wooden frame, an irregular, yellowish-brown material, possibly animal hide, is tightly stretched and attached to the frame at the edges. Across the surface of this material, there are several dark brown and gray diagonal, horizontal, and vertical laces or bindings, intersecting in a web-like manner. Some of the bindings appear to be strips of the same material, while others resemble rope. There is a small white patch in the middle of the yellowish-brown material, near the center. The background is plain and light-colored, and the image is bordered by a thin, faint rectangular outline. The drawing includes an artist's signature at the bottom right.
title: Child's Chair (View of Seat Bottom)
